triage.summary: Lucía Martín says her company changed banks and asks Alex to update payment records to a new IBAN, stop using the old account, and confirm. She says the old account closes tomorrow.
triage.risk_reason: The email requests a change to payment bank details and uses urgency tied to an account closure tomorrow, creating a risk of payment diversion.
